name: Captain America

moves.name: Shield Throw
moves.description: Hurls the shield to disarm or stagger a foe; it ricochets and returns next round.

moves.name: Ricochet Volley
moves.description: Banks the shield off walls to strike up to three targets before it comes back.

moves.name: Shield Bash
moves.description: Drives the shield edge-first into a foe with his full weight behind it.

moves.name: Combination
moves.description: A boxing and judo chain too fast and clean for most opponents to answer.

moves.name: Shield Block
moves.description: Absorbs almost any single incoming blow or blast behind the vibranium disc.

moves.name: Shield Vault
moves.description: Plants the shield as a step to vault a gap, a wall, or an enemy's guard.

moves.name: Takedown
moves.description: Grapples and pins a foe to the ground for a round.

moves.name: Rally
moves.description: Spends the round calling the play; allies with positive relationship gain a buff.

moves.name: Recover Shield
moves.description: Dives for a lost or thrown shield and returns it to hand.

moves.name: Rescue
moves.description: Puts his body and shield between a civilian and harm for the round; raises morale.

leitmotif: Slow march in a major key, snare rolls under a brass-like square lead; a lone horn line when the shield is lost.
